description: Full polish pass to make FlapFight a top-tier app: visuals, feel, sound, UX

userStories.title: Tune physics for tight, responsive feel
userStories.description: Adjust gravity, impulse, damping, and add velocity clamping so the bird feels snappy and responsive like the original Flappy Bird. The current feel is floaty and imprecise.
acceptanceCriteria: Increase gravity to around -12 to -15 for snappier fall
Adjust flapImpulse proportionally so a single tap gives ~80-100pt lift
Add max fall speed clamping in update() (cap downward velocity at ~500 pts/s)
Increase linear damping to 0.3 for tighter response
Reduce angular damping to 0.5 for more natural rotation
Bird should feel like it has weight — quick fall, punchy flap
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: GameScene.swift lines 6-11 for tunables, lines 93-96 for damping. Test by feel — bird should reach apex quickly after tap and fall decisively.

userStories.title: Replace circle bird with a stylized character
userStories.description: The bird is currently a plain white circle. Replace it with a composed SKNode that looks like an actual bird using SKShapeNode paths — body, eye, beak, and a wing that animates on tap. Keep it programmatic (no image assets). Match the neo/brutal aesthetic with white/red colors.
acceptanceCriteria: Bird is a composed SKNode with body, eye dot, triangular beak, and wing shape
Body is still roughly 18pt radius for physics but visually more interesting
Wing animates on each tap (quick rotation or scale, 100ms)
Bird bobs gently up/down (~3pt amplitude, ~2Hz) during ready state (hasStarted==false)
Death adds a spin/tumble animation (angular impulse) before freezing
Ghost bird keeps the simpler circle shape but at 0.5 alpha (more visible)
Physics body remains circleOfRadius 18 for consistent collision
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: Use SKShapeNode with CGPath for the beak and wing. Add the eye as a small filled circle child node. The wing can be an arc or triangle that rotates on tap.

userStories.title: Make pipes clearly visible with neo styling
userStories.description: Pipes are nearly invisible (15% fill opacity). Make them prominent with higher contrast and a colored accent. They should read instantly as obstacles.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipe fill opacity increased to 0.25-0.35 (semi-translucent, not solid)
Pipe stroke opacity increased to 0.6-0.8 with lineWidth 2
Add a subtle colored accent: faint red or cyan inner glow/stroke
Pipe end caps: add a wider rectangle (pipeWidth + 12) at the gap-facing end of each pipe, 8pt tall
Pipes should be immediately obvious against the dark background
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: GameScene.swift pipeNode() at line 311-326. End caps are a child SKShapeNode positioned at the gap-facing edge. Keep cornerRadius on main body.

userStories.title: Add visible ground with scrolling texture
userStories.description: The ground is currently an invisible physics collider. Add a visible ground bar that scrolls left with the pipes to create a sense of forward motion.
acceptanceCriteria: Visible ground bar at y=40, full width, ~40pt tall
Ground color: white at ~20% opacity with a brighter top edge line
Ground scrolls left at the same speed as pipes (scrollSpeed)
Ground repeats seamlessly (two ground nodes that cycle)
Ground is behind pipes but in front of background (zPosition between -5 and 0)
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: Create two side-by-side ground rectangles. In update(), move both left. When one goes fully off-screen, reposition it to the right of the other.

userStories.title: Add background depth with parallax layers
userStories.description: The background is flat. Add 2 subtle parallax layers that scroll at different speeds to create depth. Keep it minimal and dark — neo/brutal aesthetic.
acceptanceCriteria: Far layer: very faint horizontal lines or dots, scrolling at 20% of pipe speed
Mid layer: slightly brighter subtle shapes, scrolling at 50% of pipe speed
Both layers use white with very low opacity (5-12%)
Layers repeat seamlessly like the ground
Layers only scroll when hasStarted is true
Do not obscure pipes or bird visibility
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: Create each layer as a wide SKShapeNode or set of small nodes. Scroll in update() using scaledDt multiplied by the layer's speed factor.

userStories.title: Add particle effects for score, near-miss, and death
userStories.description: Add SpriteKit particle effects for key game events. Use SKEmitterNode created programmatically (no .sks files).
acceptanceCriteria: Score: 5-8 small white particles burst upward from bird position, fade out over 0.4s
Near-miss: 3-5 cyan spark particles around bird, random angles, fade over 0.3s
Death: 12-15 red/white particles explode outward from bird position, fade over 0.5s
All particles are programmatic SKEmitterNode (no asset files)
Particles auto-remove after completing
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: Create helper method makeEmitter(color:count:speed:lifetime:). Call from didBegin() for score, triggerNearMiss() for near-miss, and die() for death. Set emitter.targetNode = self.

userStories.title: Improve sound design with richer synthesis
userStories.description: Current sounds are basic single-frequency tones. Make them more interesting with frequency sweeps, harmonics, and better envelopes while keeping them procedural.
acceptanceCriteria: Flap: frequency sweep 2200→1600 Hz over 80ms, exponential decay
Score: two-tone chord (880 + 1100 Hz), 120ms, exponential decay
Death: low rumble 150→60 Hz sweep over 200ms
Near-miss: high shimmer 2800 Hz with vibrato (±200 Hz at 30 Hz), 60ms
All sounds still procedural — no audio asset files
Master volume stays at 0.3
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: GameFX.swift GameAudio class. Extend tone() to support freq sweeps (lerp freq over time), chords (sum waveforms), exponential envelopes (pow(1-t/dur, 2)).

userStories.title: Polish death screen with conditional messaging and animation
userStories.description: The death overlay just says 'DEAD' regardless of performance. Make it responsive to how the player did, with entrance animation.
acceptanceCriteria: If new best score: show 'NEW BEST!' in gold/yellow above the score
Score displays large (36pt+) with the actual number prominent
If challenge mode and score >= target: show 'YOU WIN!' instead of 'DEAD'
If challenge mode and score < target: show 'SO CLOSE!' with target comparison
Overlay slides up from below with a subtle bounce animation
Tap-to-restart text pulses gently (opacity animation)
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: showDeathOverlay() in GameScene.swift. Add a bestScore property to GameScene so it can detect new records. Pass bestScore from RootView via GameContainerView.

userStories.title: Polish ready state with animated hint
userStories.description: The ready state shows small 'TAP' text. Make it more engaging with a pulsing hint and ensure nothing starts before the first tap.
acceptanceCriteria: TAP text is larger (24pt) and pulses (opacity 0.4→1.0 loop, ~1.5s cycle)
Hint text fades out over 200ms on first tap instead of instant removal
Pipes don't spawn until after first tap
Score label is hidden during ready state, appears on first tap
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: GameScene.swift buildScene() for hint creation, handleTap() for removal. Use SKAction.repeatForever for pulse.

userStories.title: Add restart cooldown to prevent accidental double-tap
userStories.description: After death, the next tap immediately restarts. Add a brief cooldown to prevent accidental restarts.
acceptanceCriteria: After death, ignore taps for 0.8 seconds before allowing restart
The 'Tap to restart' text only appears after the cooldown expires
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: Add canRestart flag, set false on death, true after 0.8s SKAction delay. Check in handleTap().

userStories.title: Improve challenge mode UX
userStories.description: Challenge mode starts without context. Add intro messaging and improve the code input flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Before challenge starts, show target score and 'Beat this!' during ready state
Ghost bird label shown briefly at start then fades
Invalid challenge code shows error in the input sheet (not silent failure)
Challenge code input has a paste button
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: RootView.swift for challenge input. GameScene ready state for intro messaging.

userStories.title: Force dark mode and hide status bar
userStories.description: Ensure consistent dark appearance and hide status bar for full immersion.
acceptanceCriteria: App forces dark mode via Info.plist (UIUserInterfaceStyle = Dark)
Status bar is hidden (UIStatusBarHidden = true)
Set in Info.plist properties in project.yml
Run xcodegen generate after changes
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: project.yml info.properties section. Add UIUserInterfaceStyle and UIStatusBarHidden.
